title: China&\#x27;s auto association reviews 17 automakers&\#x27; 60-day supplier payment terms
summary: The China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, commissioned by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, is assessing whether 17 major automakers pay suppliers within 60 days, including whether small and medium-sized suppliers meet that limit and whether non-SME suppliers receive at least 80% in cash or bank acceptance bills. No compliance results have been released; the review is set to proceed through company submissions, a dedicated-team check, expert evaluation and public disclosure.
